items.title: William "Ba Ba" Ridgley Interview, 1961-04-11
items.q: But Mutt and that boy, they'd ask for him all the time.

ctx.x: That's every bit of his star. He was good. People used to ask for him all the time, but he just had that bad habit, you know. I understand he's such a nice fellow. People didn't like him. But Mutt and that boy, they'd ask for him all the time.
Oh, yeah. Yeah, that's interesting to hear that that really liked Buddy, huh?
